# gravity_discovery_subnet (Resource)

Subnet the discovery role scans for devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravity_discovery_subnet" "office" {
  name        = "office"
  subnet_cidr = "10.10.0.0/24"
  # Resolver used to look up hostnames for the devices that are found
  dns_resolver = "10.10.0.1:53"
  # Forget devices that have not been seen for a day
  discovery_ttl = 86400
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `subnet_cidr` (String)

### Optional

- `discovery_ttl` (Number) How long a discovered device is remembered for, in seconds. Defaults to `86400`.
- `dns_resolver` (String) Resolver used to look up hostnames for discovered devices.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gravity_discovery_subnet.office 'office'
```
